component.name: System Monitor
सिस्टम मॉनिटर
component.summary: Inspect processes and system resource use
प्रक्रियाओं और सिस्टम संसाधनों के उपयोग की जाँच करें

description.p: System Monitor presents live process, processor, memory, disk, and network information in a sortable native view.
Process actions retain Linux permission boundaries and require explicit confirmation for destructive requests.
